card.name: Final piece of brand names and abbreviations
card.fires_on: The last piece of a split-up brand name or abbreviation in drug labels, such as the KO in TEPMETKO, the FR in eGFR, or the UC in AUC. It also appears in a file name like mycd.

modes.label: Brand name endings
modes.description: Final piece of an invented drug brand name written in capitals.
modes.example: then resume TEPMET<<KO>> at the same dose

modes.label: Abbreviation endings
modes.description: Last letters of a pharmacokinetic or lab abbreviation.
modes.example: eG<<FR>> was calculated using Modification in Diet

card.plain: It fires on the end of an odd capitalized drug name or abbreviation that the model has read in pieces.
